rationale: (ib − Δceq)/at is the textbook clean-surplus net equity payout, i.e. a sign-flipped balance-sheet net share issuance / equity-financing measure that is already a heavily published anomaly (Pontiff–Woodgate, Daniel–Titman, Bradshaw–Richardson–Sloan) and is a single-ratio identity rather than a genuine cross-theme interaction, so its higher coverage does not offset the rediscovery risk.

Signing the regime count so the short leg is specifically profitable serial issuers is a defensible diagnosis-driven fix to the archived count signal's perverse short leg, but the stated justification is backwards — an integer score on −5…+5 is *coarser*, not smoother, than the archived count×RANK product, so lumpy decile boundaries remain the main threat to the portfolio evidence.

The hypothesis is explicitly conjunctive ("distributions rising while cash generation deteriorates" is the short pole) but SUMRANK is additive, so a large payout hike with collapsing cash flow can still rank high, and each leg alone is close to already-documented change-in-payout and change-in-profitability effects measured on noisy one-year annual differences.

target_name: Stable Cash Profits With Net Distribution
rationale: Bringing in a second-moment (cash-flow volatility) channel is the most genuinely different mechanism in this batch and plausibly less spanned by RMW/CMA, though the "credible only when stable" framing again implies an interaction that an additive rank-sum of two individually known anomalies does not actually impose.

Matching the financing window to the five-year profit-trend window is a coherent capital-productivity reformulation rather than a cosmetic tweak, but five-year cumulative gross issuance scaled by current assets is close to a five-year asset-growth/external-financing proxy that CMA largely prices, and dltis includes refinancing rollover noise.

This is a horizon extension of the archived Internal Funding Share (ratio-of-sums instead of a 3-year moving average of ratios) with the same mechanism and no new economic content, exactly the kind of cosmetic variant the objective discourages, and the longer window will further thin an already 9% coverage sample.
